test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

The committee requested / the Chief Investigator / to personally / look after the matter.
solution:
The segment that contains an error in the sentence is ‘4’ i.e. look after the matter.
